resources.string: Help improve Clocklings by sharing counts of screen visits, exercise activity, and correct or incorrect answers. Cloudflare processes the IP address of your connection when the app sends the counts. PostHog receives weekly totals. You can turn sharing off at any time. Reports with too few contributions are omitted, and sending can fail. A missing total does not mean zero. Turning sharing off stops future sharing. Counts already combined cannot be removed individually.
